name: Regno sotterraneo maggiore
motif: A colossal underground stone city with bridges across cavernous tiers, ancient quarried pillars dwarfing travelers and runes cut through rock. Wide deep perspective, mineral teal and black granite.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original wide 16:9 full-bleed painterly anime fantasy Oculum background. PRIMARY SCENE: A massive deeper UNDERGROUND city of great mineral columns supporting a completely CLOSED ROCK VAULT. Luminescent crystals and blue-green fungi light tiered dwellings and subterranean rivers. Absolutely NO SKY, SUN, MOON, CLOUDS or surface opening. Keep the whole page naturally illustrated with a broad quiet darker central region for readable controls, never a blank rectangular panel. Matte hand-painted gouache, controlled anime fantasy shape design, believable organic detail and materials, no shiny 3D. First reference is ONLY brush technique: never copy its geography, composition, sunset, objects or sky. No solar disc or sky-eye. No Moon body in the sky. No coins, currency discs or round eye medallions. Clouds, only where naturally present, mix luminous BLUE dominant then INDIGO then VIOLET then PASTEL PINK. Vary architecture, scale, silhouette, viewpoint and lighting from the other themes. Tell the story through details alone. NO text, UI, writing, logos, signatures or watermarks. Entirely underground under a continuous CLOSED ROCK CEILING: no sky, sun, moon, clouds or surface opening. Local light from fungi, crystals or lamps only.
